bb.name: Coordinator
bb.description: Experimental: it may break with a bb update. Start a long-lived coordinating thread for a body of work, and let it hand each piece to a crew thread. Open its panel in the navigation rail and press New: bb's own new-thread composer opens, already set to a fresh worktree and auto permissions, and the goal you type starts the thread. It plans, keeps its memory in a folder of markdown files on the bb server, and starts crews: child threads that each work on their own branch, on its provider and model unless you pick others, from its brief and done-criteria, with the crew rules and the memory index in their first message. Told to propose crews and wait, it saves them as drafts instead, for you to edit and start. It messages, reads and closes its crews, and sets itself reminders, once or repeating (in two hours, at a time, every day), that wake it with its own note when they come due; it can list and cancel them. A crew ends its work with one handoff (done, blocked or gave up, with what it did, its evidence, concerns, deviations and findings), stored whole. Every done handoff is checked by an independent verifier the plugin starts itself: a hidden thread in the crew's environment, on another model when bb has one, that proves the claimed commit is checked out on a clean tree, runs what proves each done-criterion and returns a verdict with the output as evidence. When the crew has a pull request, a verdict that passed every criterion waits under Verifying until CI finishes on the claimed commit, and fails if CI fails. A crew's first failed verdict goes straight back to it: the plugin sends each failed criterion and its evidence to the crew's thread as a message from the verifier, and the crew fixes it and hands off again for a new check. A second failure goes to the coordinating thread, which messages the crew, asks you, or replaces it with a fresh crew that starts from its brief and its latest findings. The plugin then wakes the coordinating thread with a short message that names what happened and never quotes a crew; a done handoff reaches it only with its verdict, and its catch-up returns every update in full. It is also woken when a crew fails, waits on you or stops without a handoff, when a crew's pull request opens, merges or closes, its CI passes or fails, or a review approves it or asks for changes (read through gh every minute while CI runs, else every five), when you save a memory file or switch verification, and when one of its reminders comes due. A switch on the New page and on the board turns verification off for one coordinating thread, for handoffs made after it. Its Board, a tab in the thread and a page in the panel, shows that switch, why PR status is unavailable when gh can't read GitHub, its digest and every crew under Needs you, Ready for review, Verifying, Working, Landing, Idle or Done, live, each linked to its thread and to its pull request with its CI; a verified handoff waits under Ready for review with ✓, or under Landing while its pull request is open, a merged one is Done, one that failed again after its fix round or couldn't be verified under Needs you with ✗ or the reason, each with its verdict a click away (every criterion, its result and evidence, and the verifier's model), an unchecked one as Unverified, a blocked one under Needs you, and a draft under Needs you with Start and Edit, which opens its brief, model and environment in bb's composer and its done-criteria as a list. Each row in the panel also opens a Memory editor over the same files; every write names the version it replaces, so neither you nor the thread can silently overwrite the other.
